additional_info.subject: Additional Information
additional_info.body: We’ve observed that one of our charging stations has its fan running continuously, even when the ambient temperature is not high and the station is not under heavy load. This behavior has been consistent over time and does not seem related to charging activity or external temperature. We suspect a possible sensor issue or internal misconfiguration. Could you please perform a diagnostic check to identify the root cause and advise on any corrective action? Thank you in advance for your support.

additional_info.body:
Dear Sunil Sharma,
Thank you for your feedback and remote analysis.
I can confirm that the charger serial number is correct MP/R4170001743.
However, despite the remote diagnostics indicating normal behavior, I have personally visited the site 4 to 5 times and noticed that the fan is continuously running, regardless of the weather conditions or whether a vehicle is charging or not.
This issue seems persistent and not dependent on environmental factors or charging activity.
Could you please investigate further or suggest the next steps?
Best regards,
